description:
We are a family-owned, residential electrical company based in beautiful, historic Frederick, Md. We are two Master Electricians who love what we do. This channel is designed to educate our clientele, as well as the general public, about their home's electrical systems. Whether you own an historic home or a brand new home, your electrical systems need to be better understood so that they can make the best decisions possible in regards to their home's electrical health. 

What does "Electrical Health" mean? We define Electrical Health as the ability of your home's electrical systems to deliver efficient and safe power to your lights, outlets, heating/cooling and appliances. Subscribe to our channel to follow our content and learn more about your home's Electrical Health.

Thanks

The Lumen Brothers Team
